item.tib: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs sgrub snang srid dbang bsgyur
item.coloph: mkhas pa dmu tsha gyer med kyi bka' yi pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug nges med kho bo bdag ni dbyings kyi yum chen bya ra ma gsum gyi grogs bgyis nas/ rtse drug lhun gyi sgang spyi spungs sgrub pa'i gnas su phyin nas stong chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis bdag la brgyud cing gdams nas/ slar lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i kho bo sdom brtson tha shal ba rgod rje rgya yi rus thob tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba zog po gte rgan des/ dbal gyi phur pa nag po'i byin brlabs gnas kyi mdun zhol/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i me ro spar ba'i rlung g.yab dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dus dang skabs su bab nas/ stong chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o/ yi ge thog mar bri ba po ni rigs mthun gyi grogs po stag rgod drang srong dbang 'dus kyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing bstan skyongs dam can rnams lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
